description: This file defines the class PsrCacheAdapter, which implements caching functionality by adapting a PSR-Cache pool to the Wallet SDK's CacheInterface. It provides methods to get, set, and remove cache items using the underlying PSR-Cache pool.

classes.name: PsrCacheAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class that implements the CacheInterface using a PSR-Cache pool to provide caching functionality within the AWS SDK.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new PsrCacheAdapter with a given PSR-Cache pool.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value for the given key, returning null if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache associated with the specified key, with an optional TTL.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the cached item associated with the specified key.
